title: Escape to Vietnam | FREE Halong Bay Cruise Excursion
highlights: Visit Vietnam's iconic destinations as you explore Hanoi's culture, cruise through the Halong Bay's karsts, witness Da Nang's beauty, and stroll Hoi An's lantern-lit streets.
Cycle through the beautiful countryside from Tam Coc to Bich Dong Pagoda, passing through charming villages and lush rice paddies.
Head to the breathtaking Surprise Cave, known for its stunning cave formations and expansive chambers, a highlight of your Halong Bay cruise adventure.
Marvel at the Golden Hand Bridge in Da Nang Vietnam, an architectural wonder supported by giant stone hands.
overview:
About the tour:
Embark on an unforgettable journey through the heart of Vietnam, where ancient traditions blend seamlessly with modern vibrancy. Immerse yourself in the bustling metropolis of Ho Chi Minh City, exploring its iconic landmarks and vibrant markets. Our Vietnam tour packages are designed to take you deeper into the experience, letting you discover the hidden charms of the Mekong Delta, cruising through tranquil waterways, and experiencing local life.


Continue your adventure in the breathtaking landscapes of Northern Vietnam. Cruise through the iconic Halong Bay, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, and marvel at the limestone karsts rising from the emerald waters. Perfect for a Vietnam couple package, this journey also takes you to the Sa Pa mountains, where you can trek through diverse hill tribes and experience the cool, crisp mountain air. This extraordinary journey offers a perfect blend of culture, adventure, and relaxation, creating memories that will last a lifetime.

know_before_you_go: Please note that prices are dynamic and may change in the peak season and on blackout dates.

ID Proof is mandatory for each individual guest at the time of booking, and upon arrival. PAN Card will not be considered as a valid identity proof. All foreign nationals must carry their passport as a proof of identity.
The official currency of Vietnam is the Vietnamese Dong (VND). It’s advisable to carry some cash for small purchases, though credit cards are widely accepted.
It is advisable that you dress modestly (keeping your upper arms and legs covered) when visiting any religious sites.
Indian tourists can obtain a Vietnam visa online (E-Visa) or upon arrival at the airport with a validity of 30 days. Charges have to be paid by the tourists.
Smoking is prohibited in most public areas therefore, designated smoking areas should be used.
Always carry tissue paper or wet wipes with you as most public toilets in Vietnam do not provide them.
To mitigate health risks, it is strongly advised to refrain from drinking tap water directly in Vietnam. Instead, carry refillable water bottles.
Images are only for representation purposes.

In cases of force majeure events (e.g., natural disasters, political unrest, or other unforeseeable circumstances), [Thrillophilia] reserves the right to reschedule tours & treks or offer alternative itineraries to ensure the safety and well-being of clients and staff.
Any breakage or damage of any items in the stay property will be charged at actuals.
Kindly do not litter and help keep the destinations clean.
Please note that the timings and duration of pick-up and drop-off transfers may vary based on certain factors like traffic, weather conditions, natural calamities, etc.
Prices may fluctuate with any change in services/hotels. The difference in the cost shall be borne by the client in case of any amendment in the package due to an increase in the number of guests.

If in case any traveller wants to or decides to leave the trip in the middle, all the expenses from the point onwards will be borne by the traveller. Neither the operator nor Thrillophilia will be held responsible for such decisions or for any refund.
It is recommended that you purchase travel insurance. Please note that the travel insurance is not included in the package price.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Hanoi | Leisure Day
days.desc: Welcome to Hanoi! Upon arrival at the Noi Bai International Airport, you’ll get transferred to your hotel for check in. Once done with all the formalities, you can spend the remaining day at your own pace. You can visit various attractions like Hoan Kiem Lake, Ngoc Son Temple, and the Huc Bridge. After exploring the place, head back to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

items.title: Check-in at Hm Boutique Hotel Hanoi at 02:00 PM

days.title: Excursion to Ninh Binh
days.desc: Today, board your pre-booked transfer from the hotel and get ready to go on the Ninh Binh City tour. Visit the former capital of Vietnam - Hao Lu, and its temples of the Dinh & Le Dynasties. Then, board the boat from Hao Lu to Tam Coc, and enjoy a ride through karst landscapes and rice fields, while admiring the limestone caves. Upon reaching Tam Coc, cycle through the Vietnamese villages and rocky formations, reaching Bich Dong Pagoda. Later, get transferred to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Halong Bay | Overnight Halong Bay Cruise
days.desc: Check out of your hotel and embark on a scenic drive to Halong Bay, passing through the countryside of Northern Vietnam. Upon arrival at the Tuan Chau Marina, board your traditional sailing cruise and get ready to enjoy the views as you sail through the bay. Later, visit the Ti Top Island, and Pearl Farm Village by boat and enjoy water activities like kayaking and swimming. Savour local flavours and engage in lively entertainment options onboard. Later, have an overnight stay on the cruise.

items.title: Check-in at Halong Royal Palace Cruise
Halong Bay Overnight Cruise
items.desc:
Begin your overnight cruise in Halong Bay and receive a warm welcome with delicious lunch and drinks. 
Enjoy the breathtaking views of the bay with caves, sandy beaches, beautiful floating fishing villages, Duck Islet and unique rock formations.
You can also learn about the traditional dishes and flavors at the chef's cooking class on the cruise.
Enjoy an overnight stay at the cruise.

days.title: Transfer to Da Nang via Hanoi
days.desc: Begin your day by enjoying various activities on the cruise, including Chinese martial art - Tai Chi. Later, go on a boat ride to the Surprise Cave, the largest cave in Halong Bay and witness its cave formations hanging from the ceiling. After lunch, disembark from the cruise and get transferred to Hanoi for your flight to Da Nang. Upon arrival at Da Nang International Airport, you will be transferred to your hotel for check in and an overnight stay.

items.title: Halong Bay Cruise on a Shared basis
items.desc:
Begin your day by practicing Tai Chi, the Chinese martial art, on the Sundeck. 
Next, explore the seven new wonders of the world in Halong Bay.
Next, take a small passenger boat to reach Surprise Cave (Sung Sot), Halong Bay's largest cave spanning 12,000 square meters and admire its natural scenery.
Get back on the cruise and head to Tuan Chau Harbor.

days.title: Ba Na Hill Day Tour
days.desc: Today, get ready to explore Ba Na Hills by getting transferred to Suoi Mo Station for a cable car ride to Marseille Station. Upon reaching, your first stop will be the Golden Hand Bridge, situated nearly 1000 feet above sea level and offering stunning views of the mountains and the city below. Further, visit Linh Ung Pagoda, one of the largest pagodas (a tower-like structure) in Da Nang, along with Debay Wine Cellar, and Fantasy Park. Later, get transferred to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.desc: Check out of your hotel in Da Nang and board your pre-booked transfer to Hoi An. Upon arrival, proceed with your check in formalities, and spend the rest of the day at leisure. You can explore places such as the Fujian Assembly Hall and Hoi An Night Market, or you can stroll around the beautiful An Bang Beach. Later, head back to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.
